title: Assessing Algorithmic Bias in Language-Based Depression Detection: A Comparison of DNN and LLM Approaches

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing depression detection performance metrics (Balanced Accuracy, True Positive Rate, Precision, F1 score) and calculating Equalized Odds between male and female participants on clinical interview transcripts across DNN and LLM approaches.

Comparing depression detection performance metrics (Balanced Accuracy, True Positive Rate, Precision, F1 score) and calculating Equalized Odds among African American, Hispanic, and White/Caucasian participants on clinical interview transcripts across DNN and LLM approaches.
